column1: # The digest ledger. Adam, 2026-09-11: digests are numbered from now on, and
# the number goes in the subject line and in the .docx filename.
# This file is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for the number. It exists because the
# number is the one part of a digest that cannot be recomputed from the day's
# work: it is a running count, it goes out in a subject line to Geshe Michael,
# and a hand-typed running count is wrong eventually. tools/digest_number.py
# reads it, assigns the next number to a new date, and refuses to renumber a
# digest that has already gone out.
# The first four were sent before the numbering existed; their numbers are
# assigned here retroactively so #5 lands where Adam said it should. Their
# subject lines are not changed — they are already in three people's mailboxes.
